query:
SELECT
                e.path as "path!",
                (SELECT p.title FROM posts p WHERE '/writing/' || p.slug = e.path) as "title?",
                count(*) as "count!"
            FROM events e
            WHERE e.kind = 'pageview' AND e.path NOT LIKE '/admin%' AND e.created_at >= now() - make_interval(days => $1)
            GROUP BY e.path
            ORDER BY count(*) DESC
            LIMIT 10
